page_title: MNU 2-0 EVE | Manchester Utd v Everton 09/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' The attendance for today's match is 73601.
90+4' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
90+3' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) works the corner short.
90+3' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Jordan Pickford is equal to it and makes an easy save.
90+1' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes a short corner kick.
90+1' Antony (Manchester United) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Manchester Utd get a corner.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Ashley Young (Everton) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
89' The free kick picks out Casemiro (Manchester United) in space, but his close-range header flies miles past the left post.
89' Erik ten Hag prepares a substitution. Jonny Evans is replaced by Willy Kambwala (Manchester United).
88' That will be all from Vitali Mykolenko who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Chermiti (Everton).
88' James Tarkowski (Everton) tackles a bit over-zealously and Simon Hooper blows for a foul. Manchester Utd earn a free kick.
87' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
86' Dwight McNeil (Everton) sends a cross into the box, but Andre Onana comes off his line to gather the ball.
86' Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul. Everton have a free kick from a promising distance.
84' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) meets a cross from Ashley Young, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes well wide of the left post.
84' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
83' Substitution. Antony (Manchester United) in, Alejandro Garnacho out.

82' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper.
82' Dwight McNeil (Everton) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
81' Dwight McNeil (Everton) tries to find Dominic Calvert-Lewin, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
79' We are about to witness a substitution. Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) is replacing Kobbie Mainoo.
77' Amadou Onana (Everton) unleashes a beautiful mid-range volley to the roof of the net, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains the same.
76' Lewis Dobbin (Everton) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Dominic Calvert-Lewin.
75' Sean Dyche has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ashley Young (Everton) replacing James Garner.
73' Dominic Calvert-Lewin is not given a chance to finish after receiving a sweet pass by Andre Gomes (Everton).
72' The total number of attempts is 13:18. 7:3 – this is the current number of shots on target.
69' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) has tested the patience of referee Simon Hooper and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
68' Lewis Dobbin (Everton) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar.
67' Andre Gomes (Everton) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall.
65' Good work from Everton as they win a corner.

64' Victor Lindelof (Manchester United) reacted quickly inside the box and got on the end of the resulting corner. He hit a low drive towards the middle, but the goalkeeper pulled off a great reflex save.
64' Manchester Utd will take a corner kick.

63' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) gets inside the box and tries to beat Jordan Pickford with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. The ball is out of play and Manchester Utd manage to earn a corner.
61' Substitution. Lewis Dobbin (Everton) on for Jack Harrison.
61' Sean Dyche has decided to substitute Beto and he is replaced by Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton).
61' Substitution. Abdoulaye Doucoure walks off the pitch and Andre Gomes (Everton) comes on as a substitute.
60' Bruno Fernandes plays a lovely pass into Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the right post.
58' Andre Onana pulls off a great save to deny Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
54' CHANCE! Bruno Fernandes finds Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just over the bar!
51' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
51' James Garner (Everton) takes a short free kick.
50' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is penalised for holding. Simon Hooper signals a set piece. Everton are awarded a free kick.
50' Ben Godfrey (Everton) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
48' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
46' Ben Godfrey (Everton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Andre Onana intercepts the ball.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Simon Hooper has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' A pass lands at the feet of Dwight McNeil (Everton) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
45+4' The ball is cleared after Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

45+2' A sweet pass finds Victor Lindelof (Manchester United) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Jordan Pickford is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
45+2' Casemiro (Manchester United) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it.
45+1' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

45+1' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' James Garner (Everton) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.

42' Ben Godfrey (Everton) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Everton.
42' 7:9 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The number of shots on goal at present is 4:2.
37' James Garner (Everton) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
37' Dwight McNeil (Everton) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
36' 2 - 0 Goal! Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Jordan Pickford to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
36' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
34' The referee shows a yellow card to Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
34' Ben Godfrey (Everton) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Simon Hooper signals. It's a penalty for Manchester Utd!
34' Manchester Utd are ruled offside.
33' That looked a certain handball by Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
32' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
30' Dwight McNeil (Everton) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
29' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.

27' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) has the opportunity to threaten the opponent's goal via a free kick on the edge of the box. He hits a fine strike towards the top left corner, but Jordan Pickford denies him with a great save.
27' Manchester Utd are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
26' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Amadou Onana (Everton) for his blatant foul.
26' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.

25' James Garner (Everton) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Andre Onana was alert and the score remains the same. Amadou Onana (Everton) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
24' James Garner (Everton) prepares to take a corner kick.

24' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball goes out for a corner. Everton can continue in their attacking effort.
22' Dwight McNeil (Everton) attempts to find Jack Harrison, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
22' Ben Godfrey (Everton) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
21' Dwight McNeil (Everton) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
19' That's a well-taken pass by Jack Harrison (Everton). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
17' A precise short pass from Alejandro Garnacho releases Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot high over the bar.
15' Beto (Everton) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
14' Dwight McNeil (Everton) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
13' The ball spins out to Dwight McNeil (Everton) and his swerving volley from the edge of the box flashes just past the left post.
12' 1 - 0 Goal! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Jordan Pickford.
11' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
10' Simon Hooper blows his whistle after James Tarkowski (Everton) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. No point in arguing there. Manchester Utd will take a penalty kick.
8' Casemiro (Manchester United) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
8' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) will take a corner kick.

7' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester Utd.
7' James Garner (Everton) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
6' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee points to the corner flag and Everton will take a corner.

3' Amadou Onana (Everton) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the right side of the goal, but he can't get the power to direct it past Andre Onana, who keeps it out.
2' The resulting corner from James Garner (Everton) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

2' Dwight McNeil (Everton) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Everton force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
